name: Midara na Shasou Kara
source:
There is a train line used by a lot of people. The line, however, has a problem. That is a murderous rush hour. One day, three girls get on the same train during the rush hour, Chizuru, Aya, and Marino. They are unfortunately selected as target girls by train molesters...
